target.title: Target
target.description: Dart entry point to run, relative to the workspace or using a Lumide variable.

cwd.title: Working directory
cwd.description: Directory where the Flutter command runs. Leave empty to use the workspace root.

deviceId.title: Device ID
deviceId.description: Optional Flutter device identifier. Leave empty to use the selected device.

buildMode.title: Build mode
buildMode.description: Flutter build mode used for this configuration.

flavor.title: Flavor
flavor.description: Optional product flavor passed to Flutter.

toolArgs.title: Flutter tool arguments
toolArgs.description: Arguments passed to the Flutter tool before the target. Enter one argument per line.

args.title: Application arguments
args.description: Arguments passed to the Dart application. Enter one argument per line.

env.title: Environment variables
env.description: Environment variables for the launched process. Enter one KEY=VALUE pair per line.
